title: An unbeatable experience: Iván is the best guide.
text:
Iván is the best guide I have ever had! I was lucky to meet him four years ago, and now, on my second trip to Granada, I did not hesitate to contact him to enjoy this wonderful city again.
He is a highly qualified person, with a degree in history, possessing extensive knowledge and a passion for Granada, which allows you to experience every corner in a very special way. I have done many tours over the years, and none compare to his. Additionally, he completely adapted to our needs. I highly recommend it. Thank you very much for everything, Iván!
author: sandracX5546ZO

title: BEST TOUR IN ALL OF GRANADA
text:
The best tour of my life!!! And I have been to 55 countries.

Iván Menguiano Jiménez knew everything!!!!! A lot of good information. It was my first time in Granada, and I feel that I learned a lot about the history of Spain and Granada.
